baseline.additional_ui_changes: baseline-ui.patch (the supplied secondary UX changes, also present in after)

host: Shared Linux host, eight logical CPUs. This harness ran its benchmarks serially; unrelated host activity was not fully controlled. Treat small changes as noise, not an improvement claim.

accepted_runs.store: one warmup + five measured fresh-store rounds per phase, explicit GC enabled
accepted_runs.electron: three independent visible Electron launches per phase; Xvfb/software rendering; tracing/profiling disabled

excluded_runs: Initial pnpm invocation failed before build due to a Corepack cache permission; installed binaries used instead.
Three original stress attempts assumed offscreen rows remained mounted; current common virtualizes them. No measurements from those failures are used.
Hidden-window attempts were interrupted when requestAnimationFrame was throttled. Accepted runs use visible windows under Xvfb.
One visible fixture attempt used the legacy session.prompt test event and failed. The accepted harness uses the existing canonical startedNewTurn fixture pattern from virtual-conversation-context.
Earlier store diagnostics without working explicit GC were superseded. store-baseline-no-gc.json is historical only and is not aggregated.
One root-worktree result was overwritten by concurrent work. Accepted results were copied from the fixed isolated baseline and after worktrees.
The renderer CPU profile is a separate attribution run and is excluded from latency/CPU/RSS comparisons.

shared_worktree_experiment.disposition: Backed out experimental code and experiment-only artifacts; retained Settings spacer fix and regression test. Final chat performance code/dependency patch matches measured fd60424.
shared_worktree_experiment.evidence: Final-stream regression fails at 48d4c10: expected First and last, received First.
